svg.title: Planned food allergen analysis workflow — updated scoring and photo check
svg.desc: Planned local/cloud ingredient-label analysis. Decisions scores ingredient–allergen pairs. The label report is displayed and saved before an independent optional cloud vision check. The front photo and selected allergens are sent to the vision model. Separate reminders leave the label report unchanged.

text.tspan: Planned architecture · Ingredient-list analysis with an optional food-type cross-check
Check each allergen separately. Cloud analysis uses either the LLM or Decisions model.
Planned workflow · Model scores and common-allergen estimates do not confirm an ingredient is present.
